answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, converted to a slow vesting stream, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The ledge is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the karst. What survives to the thread is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
